product_metadata.title: WhatsBedding Throw Body Pillows Standard Size Set of 2- White Bed Pillow for Sleeping - 20x26 Inches
features: Luxury Plush Pillow: Our feather bed pillow is filled with feather make it soft and breathable. Covered with premium quality cotton fabric, to avoid feather escape efficiently.
Comfort & Support: These 2 packs bed pillows provide both gentle support and sufficient comfort for head and neck, making them suitable for side, stomach and back sleepers.

Great Size: Each standard feather pillow measures 20 x 26 inches. Our 2 packs gusseted pillows are packed in vacuum bags for shipping, once opened it will start to fluff up. Please leave 24 hours for the pillow to get fluffy.
Easy to Care: The feather pillows are designed to make your life efficient and convenient, simply put them in the washer and tumble dry.

Excellent service: We focus on customer experience and we offer 180 days satisfaction guarantee. If you have any questions, please contact us for free. Our customer service staff will reply to you within 24 hours!
